title: M1: apricity-daw crate reads and writes the DAW's warp markers in .alc and .asd
description:
## Purpose
One Rust crate, `crates/apricity-daw`, that turns a sample's warp map and a clip's settings into the DAW's sidecar bytes and back, strictly: every malformed file reported with its location. It is the ground for export (M2, M3) and import (M5), and is shared with the set export (apricitus-6edba8, same AudioClip XML) and the kit/clip-folder export (apricitus-5562e0).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  M["manifest: rhythm.warp_markers
+ your warp markers (M4)
+ tuning, stem, saved clips"] --> W["apricity_daw::WarpMap
(markers, warp on/off, mode, transpose+detune)"]
  W -->|write| ALC[".alc (gzip XML)"]
  W -->|write, if M0 go| ASD[".asd (binary)"]
  ALC -->|read| W
  ASD -->|read| W
```

## Scope
- `WarpMap` model and the beat-numbering rule from `design/daw-sidecars.md` (Apricity beat 0 = first downbeat; pickups negative).
- `.alc` reader and writer; `.asd` reader (versions M0 can decode) and writer (only on M0 **go**).
- Fixture folder with the owner's DAW-saved reference files; generated WAVs only in temp dirs.
- `design/daw-sidecars.md` §Mapping; vocabulary and glossary rows.

## Out of scope
Any CLI command (M2, M5); the set file (`.als`, apricitus-6edba8); `.adg` (apricitus-5562e0).

## Definition of Done
Checklist items that apply:
1. `features/daw/sidecar_formats.feature` + `features/daw/STEPS.md`, cucumber-rs runner `crates/apricity-daw/tests/conformance.rs`; 100% of scenarios green.
2. Rust only (no Python in this milestone; the manifest contract is unchanged).
5. Real-format fixtures in `crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/`, no audio in git.
6. §Mapping in `design/daw-sidecars.md`; `design/vocabulary.md` gains **Sidecar**.
7. `docs/glossary.md` (sidecar, `.asd`, `.alc`); README layout table row for the new crate.
9. `safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw`.
10, 11. Log on every task; `feat(<task id>)` / `chore(<task id>)`; nothing breaking.
Not applicable: 3 (schema), 4 (CLI), 8 (web).

## Dependencies
Blocked by M0 (formats and the go/no-go). Coordinate the crate with apricitus-6edba8: whichever initiative starts first creates `apricity-daw`; the other extends it.
